title: Send the player somewhere
blurb: The game tells the player what to do and draws an arrow to it.
how: @on_start runs one time, when the player arrives on your island. Nobody has to press anything.
objective("...") sets the line at the top of the screen. Keep it short, like an order: find this, talk to them.
guide_to("trophies") draws an arrow and a trail to the spot named trophies.
When the player gets there, take both down with guide_to(None) and objective(None). If you leave an arrow up it keeps pointing at a place they've already been.
try: Send the player to the computer instead. Its spot is called the_desk. You have to change two lines.
Make it two stops. When they find the trophies, set a new objective and an arrow to the president.
Make the president refuse to talk until the trophies are found. Guide 3 has what you need.
breaks: There is no spot called ... on this map
The name in guide_to or @on_talk isn't a spot on this map. The message lists the ones that are.
guide_to(None) is missing, or it's missing its yield.
objective needs yield in front, like everything else.
clip: say:@on_start runs once, when the player arrives.
say:objective is the line at the top. guide_to is the arrow.
